description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for filtering project activity detailed reports in the OrangeHRM time management plugin. It extends a base report filter class, adding specific filtering based on project activity ID and setting a default sort field.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering project activity detailed reports with an optional project activity ID and default sorting.

methods.name: getProjectActivityId
methods.description: Retrieves the current project activity ID filter value.

methods.name: setProjectActivityId
methods.description: Sets the project activity ID filter value.
